title: Version 3.1.7 Changelog
items: Accept file names with : * ? " < > | and device names like CON
Allow names up to 255 characters for new folders and renames
Give folder ZIP entries names that extract on Windows
Show files on the Cloud Drive whose names Windows cannot hold
Keep those names intact when created, renamed or saved on the Cloud Drive
Create each folder once when uploads run in parallel
Merge an uploaded folder into one whose name differs only in case
Paste folders copied in Explorer into the desktop app
List links, junctions and unreadable files skipped in a pasted folder
Show the server's reason when an upload is refused
Copy files to Explorer under names Windows accepts
Stop files whose names differ only in case overwriting each other in Explorer
Name the files that could not be copied to Explorer
Fix pasted file names with characters outside the console code page
Set Postgres with DATABASE_URL instead of DB_* variables
Set Redis with REDIS_URL instead of REDIS_* variables
Connect to Redis over TLS with rediss:// URLs
Take the Postgres and Redis container passwords from the same URLs
Rename BPORT to PORT and publish it as the host port in Docker
Redact DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL in logs
Run the backup script when piped from curl into bash
Ask for restore confirmation on the terminal when piped
